subject.title: fix(gateway): Control UI bootstrap 401s over Tailscale Serve without a token

question: Should tokenless Tailscale Control UI HTTP reads reject browser requests marked cross-site when Origin is absent, or is that residual tailnet data exposure an intentional part of the trusted-host model?
rationale: Gateway auth files are security-owned, and accepting ambient identity for origin-less browser requests changes the cross-site disclosure boundary even though the underlying Tailscale identity is verified.

options.title: Reject cross-site browser reads
options.body: Use Fetch Metadata or an equivalent request-provenance check so cross-site browser reads fail even without Origin, while retaining explicitly safe non-browser access.

options.title: Accept the trusted-tailnet exposure
options.body: Document and explicitly approve origin-less verified-tailnet reads as an intentional security tradeoff for the Control UI read surface.

options.title: Keep HTTP credentials required
options.body: Do not extend Tailscale identity to these HTTP routes until a reliable browser-provenance boundary is available.

recommendation.title: Reject cross-site browser reads
recommendation.body: Use Fetch Metadata or an equivalent request-provenance check so cross-site browser reads fail even without Origin, while retaining explicitly safe non-browser access.

likelyOwner.reason: The team is the explicit CODEOWNER for gateway authentication files and is best positioned to approve or reject the changed trust boundary.
